title: A super informative and enjoyable tour.
text: I really enjoyed my guided tour of the Cathedral today.  Alvaro our guide was amazing. He was so knowledgeable and his passion and enthusiasm made everything seem even more fascinating than it might have been. The Cathedral is a stunning building and learning its history during the tour was a great added bonus.
